items.title: predict360user
items.text: predict360user is a library that aims to help researchers to reproduce and develop models to predict user behavior in 360 videos, namely trajectory (or traject for short).

items.title: Getting Started
items.text:
• Tutorial: Check out our interactive tutorial showing how to load datasets, train, and evaluate prediction models.
  • GitHub Repository: Access the source code, contribute, or report issues.

items.title: Requirements
items.text:
The project requirements are in requirements.txt. See below how to create a conda env for that:

conda create -n p3u python==3.9 -y
conda activate p3u
pip install -r requirements.txt
conda install -c conda-forge cudatoolkit=11.2 cudnn=8.1.0

items.title: Basic Usage
items.text:
To train and evaluate the pos_only model on the david dataset:

python -m predict360user.start_run dataset=david model=pos_only
